info.name: Adelgaceya API
info.description:
Physician-supervised telehealth API for medical weight loss and metabolic programs in Peru.

## Authentication
Obtain an access token from `POST /api/v1/auth/login/` or `POST /api/v1/auth/google/`, then send it as `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`. Access tokens live 15 minutes. Refresh with `POST /api/v1/auth/token/refresh/`; refresh tokens rotate and the previous token is blacklisted. Never place PHI in query strings.

## Errors
Every error uses `{code, message, details, request_id}` and echoes `X-Request-ID`. Object-level access failures return 404 to avoid revealing the existence of clinical records.

## Using this collection
1. Set `baseUrl` (default `http://localhost:8000`).
2. Set `email` and `password` (demo emails per role are in the `*_email` variables; the password is the one passed to `make seed`).
3. Run **Auth → Log in**. Tokens are saved automatically. For MFA accounts, run **Auth → MFA verify** with the TOTP code; it also saves tokens.
4. Fill the id variables (`assessment_id`, `order_id`, ...) before calling detail endpoints. Every 201 response stores its `id` in `last_created_id`.
5. `Idempotency-Key` is a fresh GUID per send; `If-Match` uses `if_match`.
6. Webhook requests need a valid provider signature and will be rejected otherwise.

Generated from OpenAPI 1.2.0 by `scripts/build_postman.py`.
